name: Kumkumadi
subtitle: Saffron & Manjistha Scalp Oil
tagline: From India's Roots to Your Roots.
description: A luxurious, golden infusion inspired by ancient royal rituals. Kumkumadi brings the clarifying and invigorating properties of pure Saffron to the scalp, partnered with the deeply purifying essence of Manjistha root. Gently steeped in a base of warm Sesame oil alongside delicate Lotus petals, this opulent blend clears away buildup, encourages a balanced, healthy scalp environment, and imparts a subtle, luminous sheen to your hair.

ingredients.name: Saffron Threads
ingredients.role: Stimulates blood flow to the scalp and promotes a healthy, even tone

ingredients.name: Manjistha Root
ingredients.role: Purifies the scalp and clears away lingering congestion

ingredients.name: Lotus Petals
ingredients.role: Soothes inflammation and adds a delicate, conditioning touch

ingredients.name: Sesame Seed Oil
ingredients.role: A warming, deeply penetrative base that locks in botanical nourishment

whyThisHerb: Saffron is a revered botanical treasure that invigorates and balances the skin of the scalp, while Manjistha works beneath the surface to purify, creating the optimal foundation for resilient hair.

howToUse.title: Section
howToUse.description: Part your hair into clean sections, exposing the scalp to receive the golden oil directly.

howToUse.title: Massage
howToUse.description: Use gentle, circular motions with your fingertips to work the oil into the roots, encouraging circulation.

howToUse.title: Steep
howToUse.description: Allow the rich botanicals to absorb for at least 45 minutes, letting the saffron work its clarifying magic.

howToUse.title: Wash
howToUse.description: Cleanse thoroughly with a mild shampoo to reveal a deeply nourished, refreshed scalp.
